data.name: Balthor
data.long_meaning: In Hebrew, Balthor is derived from the words 'bal' (lord) and 'thor' (protector). The name Balthor represents the protector of God in Christianity, originating from the Old Testament figure Baal, a pagan god of protection. In Christian tradition, this name is symbolic of God's guardianship and protection over His people.

in_hebrew.name: בלתור
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם בלתור הוא שילוב של שני מילים עבריות: בעל ו תור. בעל פירושו אדון או שוער, ותור פירושו שור או בקר. השם בלתור יכול להתפרש כאדון השור או השוער של תור. מבחינה היסטורית, השם בלתור לא מופיע ישירות בתנ"ך, אך המרכיבים שלו מופיעים במקומות שונים. השם נושא משמעות של כוח, עוצמה ומזל.

in_greek.name: Βάλθορ
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Βάλθορ είναι σύνθεση δύο ελληνικών λέξεων: Βάλ, που σημαίνει κυρίαρχος ή άρχοντας, και θορ, που σημαίνει ταύρος. Το όνομα Βάλθορ μπορεί να ερμηνευτεί ως ο κυρίαρχος του ταύρου ή ο ισχυρός όπως ο ταύρος. Ιστορικά, το όνομα Βάλθορ δεν εμφανίζεται άμεσα στην Καινή Διαθήκη, αλλά τα συστατικά του βρίσκονται σε διάφορα μέρη. Το όνομα φέρει σημασία δύναμης, ισχύος και τύχης.

in_latin.name: Balthor
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Balthor ex duobus verbis Latinis componitur: Balt, quod significat dominus vel princeps, et thor, quod significat taurum. Nomen Balthor interpretari potest ut Dominus tauri aut potens ut taurus. Historice, nomen Balthor non apparet directe in Ecclesia primitiva, sed componentia eius inveniuntur in variis locis. Nomen habet significationem fortitudinis, potentiae et felicitatis.

in_english.name: Balthor
in_english.meaning: Balthor - Lord of the Bull or Powerful like a Bull
in_english.long_meaning: The name Balthor is derived from two ancient roots, suggesting a powerful and strong individual. Although not directly mentioned in the Bible, its components reflect themes of strength and dominance. Historically, names with similar roots were used in early Christian traditions to signify power and protection. The name Balthor conveys a sense of courage, resilience, and leadership, making it a meaningful choice for a child.

data.cultural_impact: The name Balthor holds historical significance as it is derived from the ancient name Baal, a pagan god of protection. However, its Christian derivation reflects the shift from idol worship to monotheistic faith. It represents the transition from a polytheistic society to a monotheistic one, symbolizing the replacement of pagan gods by the Christian God.
data.spiritual_significance: Balthor is a deeply spiritual name that embodies God's protective nature. The name exudes a sense of safety, security, and strength, representing the Christian belief that God is always present and looking out for His believers. It is a reminder of God's promise to be a shield and protector to His people, as expressed in Psalm 3:3 – "But thou, O LORD, art a shield about me, my glory, and the lifter of my head."

historical_references.reference: Balthor the Brave, also known as Balthasar, was a legendary Danish prince of the early 12th century. He was the son of King Sweyn II and was known for his courage and generosity.

Balthor, also known as Balthazar, was one of the Three Wise Men who visited the infant Jesus. According to the New Testament of the Bible, they presented Him with gifts of gold, frankincense, and myrrh.

modern_usage.modern_context: In modern popular culture, the name 'Balthor' is often associated with dark fantasy, tabletop role-playing games, and steampunk. In literature, Balthor can be found as a character name in various dark fantasy novels, adding an air of mystery and intrigue. In the realm of tabletop role-playing games, Balthor is a popular name for characters in games like Dungeons & Dragons, exemplifying the heroic or villainous archetypes common in the genre. Finally, in video games, Balthor is a name used for characters in steampunk titles such as 'Baldur's Gate: Siege of Dragonspear' or 'Warhammer: End Times - Vermintide'. Overall, the name 'Balthor' has come to symbolize a sense of adventure, intrigue, and the unknown within these genres and platforms.

data.spiritual_symbolism: Balthor: Bal - Power, Thorr - Thor, God of Thunder. A name representing the divine power of God, symbolized by the might and strength of Thor. It is a name for those who seek divine protection and strength in the face of adversity.
